# Simple Neovim for Salesforce, Golang and Typescript development

This config was aimed to be minimalistic ➰, yet still appealing ✨ and ⚡ fast. Current startup time is 25ms on my MacAir.  

![startup screen](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/14210106/412847578-7971330b-1ee4-472f-9ccc-a5891ff4fb3e.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..I6BUT6jPZbHx9Mxp9HQ2lHBvc71JsDDntM55xuZZwCQ](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/14210106/412847578-7971330b-1ee4-472f-9ccc-a5891ff4fb3e.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..qhgFHiS5Ch3gSiKvqKGi97B3KYDExjz86XDGtJZbvVg)

# How to use
Install neovim:
```
brew install neovim
```
Clone this repo to the `~config/nvim` path:
```
git clone git@github.com:jasmine-nguyen/nvimconf.git ~/.config/nvim
```
Run neovim in your terminal:
```
nvim
```
**Note** First start up will take more times as plugins are being installed for the first time. Also make sure you run `:checkhealth` to ensure everything is installed correctly. You might need to install extra dependencies using `brew` as per `checkhealth` result.
